neutral_algebra.conventions: Full normalized Fock Hilbert-Schmidt inner product, restricted to all charge-neutral matrix units. L=(D+Db)/2, T=(D-Db)/2, Cx has rank eigenvalue r(N+1-r). D/Db retain neighboring-charge blocks; the adjoint is the full-neutral HS adjoint.
neutral_algebra.spin_scope: On rank r the auxiliary spin is J=N/2-r, while L has eigenvalues r,r+1,...,N-r. Thus R=N/2-J and R<=L. J is a spin label, not the operator L itself.

integer_weights.analytic_positivity: Mahonian reflection pairs a=j^2-4*inv with 2j-a. Writing the pair j+y,j-y gives (j+y)^d+(j-y)^d=2*sum_even_l binom(d,l)*j^(d-l)*y^l>=0. The unpaired central term, if present, is j^d. This is an all-d analytic argument; enumeration checks only d<=256.

probabilities.rigorous_tail: For z=exp(t)>0 rational, |j^2-4 inv|<=j^2 and exp(-lambda*j^2)/Z_j<=1 give the exact rational bound j!*(lambda*j^2*z)^(D+1)/(D+1)!/(1-lambda*j^2*z/(D+2)). First/second moment tails use d/d!=1/(d-1)! and d^2/d!=1/(d-2)!+1/(d-1)!.
probabilities.arithmetic_scope: The rational tail bounds are exact. Exponentials, MGF differences and displayed probabilities are 80/120-digit refinement checks, not interval-rounded evaluations. The normalized MGF includes division by Z_j.

scope: Exact finite full-neutral superoperator identities and an independently normalized analytic candidate defect law. These checks do not establish convergence of the actual finite-N rank distribution or its MGF, nor a finite-time mixed memory kernel.
reproducibility: Deterministic enumeration and arithmetic, no random seed. Only this fresh driver main is executed; output is exclusive-create.
